get.description:
Items of a library. `filter=field:value` (repeatable) narrows to a group of the
tree; `where` are a view's conditions (selectors.conditions), all or any of them per
`match`; `q` searches all fields including barcodes; `work` limits to one game.
`section` (a grouping field) orders the list by its groups and returns their headings;
an item in several groups is listed in each.
Nested groups with counts, e.g. group_by=platform&group_by=publisher&group_by=year.

PlatformListOut.description: For the platforms page: pictures, facts and how many games the catalog has.
PlatformListOut.title: PlatformListOut

ManufacturerOut.description: The catalog company the manufacturer's name is (for a link to its page).
ManufacturerOut.title: ManufacturerOut

PlatformDetailOut.description:
For the platform's page and edit page: picture, description (the reader's language,
else another), facts, its IGDB id and whether it can be deleted.
PlatformDetailOut.title: PlatformDetailOut

PlatformRefOut.description: Another platform (a predecessor, a successor), enough for its badge.
PlatformRefOut.title: PlatformRefOut

MediaType.description: Kind of medium: games, figures (amiibo …); video is reserved for DVD/Blu-ray.
MediaType.title: MediaType

PlatformGamesOut.description: A platform's games and what they have in common.
PlatformGamesOut.title: PlatformGamesOut

EditionOut.title: EditionOut

DatePrecision.description:
How exact a release date is: "28.04.2017", "March 2026", "Q3 2026", "TBA" …

The release stores the first day of the period; the end and the sort date follow
from it (models/dates.py).
DatePrecision.title: DatePrecision

FactOut.description: A cached fact of a game from one source (HowLongToBeat, OpenCritic …).
FactOut.title: FactOut

Region.description: Release region as printed on the box. PAL covers Europe/Australia in general.
Region.title: Region

ReleaseIn.description:
Manual entry when no provider knows the game. work_id adds a release to an
existing work (e.g. the same game on another platform).
ReleaseIn.title: ReleaseIn

TermRef.description:
A picked term: an existing one by `id`, or a new one by `name` (created on save;
a name that exists already, in any case, is that term).

ReleasePatch.description: Fields of one release. The game itself (genres, developers, summary) is WorkPatch.

MoveReleaseIn.description: Target game, or none to make the release a game of its own (with `title`).

ReviewEntryOut.description: One unreviewed catalog entry: a game, a release or a barcode.
ReviewEntryOut.title: ReviewEntryOut

TermSuggestionOut.description: A term in suggestions and on its kind's overview page.
TermSuggestionOut.title: TermSuggestionOut

CompanyDetailsOut.description: What is known about a company besides its games (empty strings / null: unknown).
CompanyDetailsOut.title: CompanyDetailsOut

TermDetailOut.description:
A term's page: its games, oldest first (for a company: developed in `works`,
published – a release of – in `published`) and what they have in common.
TermDetailOut.title: TermDetailOut

CompanyDetailsIn.description: All of a company's details at once (the edit page sends them together).
CompanyDetailsIn.title: CompanyDetailsIn

SeriesDetailsIn.description: A series' franchise (an existing one, or none).
SeriesDetailsIn.title: SeriesDetailsIn

DescriptionCandidateOut.description: An encyclopedia entry that may describe a company or series.
DescriptionCandidateOut.title: DescriptionCandidateOut

ViewerLoans.description: What a library's viewers see of loans.
ViewerLoans.title: ViewerLoans

ItemPageOut.title: ItemPageOut
